scope.sourceRestore: Read-only inspection of unchanged V34 backup restore.
scope.releaseRestore: Separate restore; checked-in V35-V42 SQL applied in individual transactions, followed by individual CHECK validation attempts. Flyway history unchanged; not a full Flyway deployment.

sourceConstraints.definition: CHECK (((state_revision IS NULL) OR (state_revision >= 0))) NOT VALID

CHECK ((((sales_status)::text = '취소'::text) OR (sales_type IS NULL) OR (((sales_type)::text = 'DIRECT'::text) AND ((sales_status)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('작성중'::character varying)::text, ('출고 완료'::character varying)::text]))) OR (((sales_type)::text = 'AUCTION'::text) AND ((sales_status)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('작성중'::character varying)::text, ('출하 완료'::character varying)::text]))))) NOT VALID
sourceConstraints.expression: (((sales_status)::text = '취소'::text) OR (sales_type IS NULL) OR (((sales_type)::text = 'DIRECT'::text) AND ((sales_status)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('작성중'::character varying)::text, ('출고 완료'::character varying)::text]))) OR (((sales_type)::text = 'AUCTION'::text) AND ((sales_status)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('작성중'::character varying)::text, ('출하 완료'::character varying)::text]))))

releaseSchemaRehearsal.method: Checked-in V35-V42 SQL applied transactionally to a second restored DB; no Flyway history edits.

releaseConstraintsAfter.definition: CHECK (((quantity > 0) AND (unit_price >= 0) AND (amount >= 0) AND ((amount)::bigint = ((quantity)::bigint * (unit_price)::bigint)))) NOT VALID

CHECK ((((sales_status)::text = '취소'::text) OR (sales_type IS NULL) OR (((sales_type)::text = 'DIRECT'::text) AND ((sales_status)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('작성중'::character varying)::text, ('출고 완료'::character varying)::text]))) OR (((sales_type)::text = 'AUCTION'::text) AND ((sales_status)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('작성중'::character varying)::text, ('출하 완료'::character varying)::text])))))

ledgerReconciliation.target: Release restore on PostgreSQL 14.24, SELECT-only reader; Flyway and startup settlement disabled.

dataPreservation.method: Ordered row-JSON hashes and counts of all original V34 columns in each original public table. Compared unchanged restore with schema-rehearsal restore after validation and ledger CLI. No row values or authentication-table hashes published.

legacyReturns.assessment: Amounts match quantity times unit price. Legacy signed return records conflict with V35 positivity rules; not arithmetic corruption. V35 SQL succeeds with NOT VALID; validation fails, and subsequent updates to violating rows may be rejected. Preserve originals; historical-return handling must be decided before money CHECK validation.

paymentCoverage.assessment: Historical paid amounts have no event provenance in this backup. Not evidence of 148 incorrect payments. Bank/original receipts required; do not synthesize payment events.

workTime.assessment: 40 end dates precede recorded start. Current start(now) and completionTime(completedDate) allow registration time and retrospective work day to mix. Review semantics; no quantity or ledger corruption established and no timestamps rewritten.

auctionIdenticalRows.assessment: 32 same-attempt groups, 43 excess identical economic rows; multiple result lines are allowed. Totals reconcile. Old request identity absent; duplicate requests not established; no deduplication.

limits: Snapshot invariants do not prove absence of all historical bugs or deleted history.
Actual primary DB validation and full Flyway rollout not performed.
External bank/payment facts, past request replay corpus and production-load assessment not supplied or performed.
V35-V42 schema rehearsal alone is not application workflow or concurrency regression verification.

businessAuditSql: BEGIN ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY; SET LOCAL row_security=off; SET LOCAL lock_timeout='3s'; SET LOCAL statement_timeout='5min';
SELECT jsonb_build_object('report','SNAPSHOT','readOnly',current_setting('transaction_read_only'),'snapshot',pg_current_snapshot()::text,'checkedAt',transaction_timestamp());

WITH violations AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT g.id FROM orchid_groups g LEFT JOIN (SELECT a.orchid_group_id,sum(a.allocated_quantity)::numeric expected FROM sales_slip_item_allocations a JOIN sales_slip_items i ON i.id=a.sales_slip_item_id JOIN sales_slips s ON s.id=i.sales_slip_id WHERE s.sales_status='작성중' GROUP BY a.orchid_group_id) r ON r.orchid_group_id=g.id WHERE g.reserved_quantity IS DISTINCT FROM coalesce(r.expected,0)) SELECT jsonb_build_object('code','GROUP_RESERVATION_MISMATCH','kind','INVARIANT','count',count(*),'sampleIds',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(id ORDER BY id) FROM (SELECT id FROM violations ORDER BY id LIMIT 50) s),'[]'::jsonb)) FROM violations;

WITH violations AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT id FROM sales_slip_items WHERE amount::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM quantity::numeric*unit_price::numeric) SELECT jsonb_build_object('code','SALES_ITEM_ARITHMETIC_MISMATCH','kind','INVARIANT','count',count(*),'sampleIds',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(id ORDER BY id) FROM (SELECT id FROM violations ORDER BY id LIMIT 50) s),'[]'::jsonb)) FROM violations;

WITH violations AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT id FROM sales_slip_items WHERE quantity<=0) SELECT jsonb_build_object('code','SALES_ITEM_NONPOSITIVE_QUANTITY','kind','POLICY_REVIEW','count',count(*),'sampleIds',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(id ORDER BY id) FROM (SELECT id FROM violations ORDER BY id LIMIT 50) s),'[]'::jsonb)) FROM violations;

WITH violations AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT id FROM sales_slip_items WHERE unit_price<0 OR amount<0) SELECT jsonb_build_object('code','SALES_ITEM_NEGATIVE_PRICE_OR_AMOUNT','kind','POLICY_REVIEW','count',count(*),'sampleIds',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(id ORDER BY id) FROM (SELECT id FROM violations ORDER BY id LIMIT 50) s),'[]'::jsonb)) FROM violations;

WITH violations AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT s.id FROM sales_slips s LEFT JOIN (SELECT sales_slip_id,sum(amount)::numeric total FROM sales_slip_items GROUP BY sales_slip_id) i ON i.sales_slip_id=s.id WHERE s.total_amount::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM coalesce(i.total,0)) SELECT jsonb_build_object('code','SALES_TOTAL_MISMATCH','kind','INVARIANT','count',count(*),'sampleIds',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(id ORDER BY id) FROM (SELECT id FROM violations ORDER BY id LIMIT 50) s),'[]'::jsonb)) FROM violations;

WITH violations AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT id FROM sales_slips WHERE total_amount<0) SELECT jsonb_build_object('code','SALES_NEGATIVE_TOTAL','kind','POLICY_REVIEW','count',count(*),'sampleIds',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(id ORDER BY id) FROM (SELECT id FROM violations ORDER BY id LIMIT 50) s),'[]'::jsonb)) FROM violations;

WITH violations AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT id FROM sales_slips WHERE paid_amount<0) SELECT jsonb_build_object('code','SALES_NEGATIVE_PAID_AMOUNT','kind','POLICY_REVIEW','count',count(*),'sampleIds',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(id ORDER BY id) FROM (SELECT id FROM violations ORDER BY id LIMIT 50) s),'[]'::jsonb)) FROM violations;

WITH violations AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT id FROM sales_slips WHERE coalesce(remaining_amount,0)::numeric <> greatest(0::numeric,total_amount::numeric-coalesce(paid_amount,0)::numeric)) SELECT jsonb_build_object('code','SALES_REMAINING_MISMATCH','kind','INVARIANT','count',count(*),'sampleIds',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(id ORDER BY id) FROM (SELECT id FROM violations ORDER BY id LIMIT 50) s),'[]'::jsonb)) FROM violations;

WITH violations AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT i.id FROM sales_slip_items i JOIN (SELECT sales_slip_item_id,sum(allocated_quantity)::numeric total FROM sales_slip_item_allocations GROUP BY sales_slip_item_id) a ON a.sales_slip_item_id=i.id WHERE a.total IS DISTINCT FROM i.quantity::numeric) SELECT jsonb_build_object('code','SALES_ALLOCATED_ITEM_QUANTITY_MISMATCH','kind','INVARIANT','count',count(*),'sampleIds',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(id ORDER BY id) FROM (SELECT id FROM violations ORDER BY id LIMIT 50) s),'[]'::jsonb)) FROM violations;

WITH violations AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT a.id FROM sales_slip_item_allocations a LEFT JOIN orchid_groups g ON g.id=a.orchid_group_id WHERE g.id IS NULL) SELECT jsonb_build_object('code','SALES_ALLOCATION_DANGLING_GROUP','kind','INVARIANT','count',count(*),'sampleIds',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(id ORDER BY id) FROM (SELECT id FROM violations ORDER BY id LIMIT 50) s),'[]'::jsonb)) FROM violations;

WITH violations AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT id FROM sales_inventory_movements WHERE (mutation_id IS NULL) <> (correlation_id IS NULL)) SELECT jsonb_build_object('code','SALES_MOVEMENT_INCOMPLETE_MUTATION_LINK','kind','INVARIANT','count',count(*),'sampleIds',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(id ORDER BY id) FROM (SELECT id FROM violations ORDER BY id LIMIT 50) s),'[]'::jsonb)) FROM violations;

WITH violations AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT s.id FROM sales_inventory_movements s LEFT JOIN orchid_group_mutations m ON m.id=s.mutation_id WHERE s.mutation_id IS NOT NULL AND m.id IS NULL) SELECT jsonb_build_object('code','SALES_MOVEMENT_DANGLING_MUTATION','kind','INVARIANT','count',count(*),'sampleIds',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(id ORDER BY id) FROM (SELECT id FROM violations ORDER BY id LIMIT 50) s),'[]'::jsonb)) FROM violations;

WITH violations AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT id FROM auction_shipment_lots WHERE waiting_quantity <> greatest(0,shipped_quantity::numeric-sold_quantity::numeric-returned_quantity::numeric)) SELECT jsonb_build_object('code','AUCTION_LOT_WAITING_MISMATCH','kind','INVARIANT','count',count(*),'sampleIds',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(id ORDER BY id) FROM (SELECT id FROM violations ORDER BY id LIMIT 50) s),'[]'::jsonb)) FROM violations;

WITH violations AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT l.id FROM auction_shipment_lots l LEFT JOIN (SELECT a.shipment_lot_id,sum(r.quantity)::numeric total FROM auction_attempts a JOIN auction_result_lines r ON r.auction_attempt_id=a.id WHERE r.amount>0 GROUP BY a.shipment_lot_id) sold ON sold.shipment_lot_id=l.id WHERE l.sold_quantity::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM coalesce(sold.total,0)) SELECT jsonb_build_object('code','AUCTION_LOT_SOLD_RESULT_MISMATCH','kind','REVIEW','count',count(*),'sampleIds',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(id ORDER BY id) FROM (SELECT id FROM violations ORDER BY id LIMIT 50) s),'[]'::jsonb)) FROM violations;

WITH violations AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT id FROM auction_shipment_lots WHERE shipped_quantity<0 OR sold_quantity<0 OR returned_quantity<0 OR waiting_quantity<0) SELECT jsonb_build_object('code','AUCTION_LOT_NEGATIVE_QUANTITY','kind','INVARIANT','count',count(*),'sampleIds',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(id ORDER BY id) FROM (SELECT id FROM violations ORDER BY id LIMIT 50) s),'[]'::jsonb)) FROM violations;

WITH violations AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT id FROM auction_shipment_lots WHERE sold_quantity::numeric+returned_quantity::numeric>shipped_quantity::numeric) SELECT jsonb_build_object('code','AUCTION_LOT_EXCEEDS_SHIPMENT','kind','REVIEW','count',count(*),'sampleIds',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(id ORDER BY id) FROM (SELECT id FROM violations ORDER BY id LIMIT 50) s),'[]'::jsonb)) FROM violations;

WITH violations AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT l.id FROM auction_shipment_lots l WHERE l.current_status='WAITING' AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM auction_attempts a WHERE a.shipment_lot_id=l.id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM auction_lot_status_history h WHERE h.shipment_lot_id=l.id))) SELECT jsonb_build_object('code','AUCTION_WAITING_WITH_HISTORY','kind','CANDIDATE','count',count(*),'sampleIds',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(id ORDER BY id) FROM (SELECT id FROM violations ORDER BY id LIMIT 50) s),'[]'::jsonb)) FROM violations;

WITH violations AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT min(id) id FROM auction_attempts GROUP BY shipment_lot_id,auction_date,attempt_no HAVING count(*)>1) SELECT jsonb_build_object('code','AUCTION_DUPLICATE_ATTEMPT_NUMBER','kind','CANDIDATE','count',count(*),'sampleIds',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(id ORDER BY id) FROM (SELECT id FROM violations ORDER BY id LIMIT 50) s),'[]'::jsonb)) FROM violations;

WITH violations AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT min(r.id) id FROM auction_result_lines r JOIN auction_attempts a ON a.id=r.auction_attempt_id GROUP BY a.shipment_lot_id,r.auction_date,r.auction_grade,r.quantity,r.unit_price,r.amount,r.inspection_status HAVING count(*)>1) SELECT jsonb_build_object('code','AUCTION_IDENTICAL_RESULT_ROWS','kind','CANDIDATE','count',count(*),'sampleIds',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(id ORDER BY id) FROM (SELECT id FROM violations ORDER BY id LIMIT 50) s),'[]'::jsonb)) FROM violations;

WITH violations AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT s.id FROM auction_settlements s LEFT JOIN (SELECT settlement_id,sum(amount)::numeric total FROM auction_settlement_lines GROUP BY settlement_id) l ON l.settlement_id=s.id WHERE s.gross_amount::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM coalesce(l.total,0)) SELECT jsonb_build_object('code','SETTLEMENT_GROSS_MISMATCH','kind','INVARIANT','count',count(*),'sampleIds',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(id ORDER BY id) FROM (SELECT id FROM violations ORDER BY id LIMIT 50) s),'[]'::jsonb)) FROM violations;

WITH violations AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT id FROM auction_settlements WHERE expected_deposit_amount::numeric <> greatest(0::numeric,gross_amount::numeric-fee_amount::numeric-deduction_amount::numeric)) SELECT jsonb_build_object('code','SETTLEMENT_EXPECTED_DEPOSIT_MISMATCH','kind','INVARIANT','count',count(*),'sampleIds',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(id ORDER BY id) FROM (SELECT id FROM violations ORDER BY id LIMIT 50) s),'[]'::jsonb)) FROM violations;

WITH violations AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT id FROM auction_settlements WHERE remaining_amount::numeric <> greatest(0::numeric,expected_deposit_amount::numeric-paid_amount::numeric)) SELECT jsonb_build_object('code','SETTLEMENT_REMAINING_MISMATCH','kind','INVARIANT','count',count(*),'sampleIds',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(id ORDER BY id) FROM (SELECT id FROM violations ORDER BY id LIMIT 50) s),'[]'::jsonb)) FROM violations;

WITH violations AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT id FROM auction_settlements WHERE gross_amount<0 OR fee_amount<0 OR deduction_amount<0 OR expected_deposit_amount<0 OR paid_amount<0 OR remaining_amount<0) SELECT jsonb_build_object('code','SETTLEMENT_NEGATIVE_AMOUNTS','kind','POLICY_REVIEW','count',count(*),'sampleIds',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(id ORDER BY id) FROM (SELECT id FROM violations ORDER BY id LIMIT 50) s),'[]'::jsonb)) FROM violations;

WITH violations AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT min(id) id FROM auction_settlements GROUP BY auction_house_id,auction_date HAVING count(*)>1) SELECT jsonb_build_object('code','SETTLEMENT_DUPLICATE_HOUSE_DAY','kind','INVARIANT','count',count(*),'sampleIds',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(id ORDER BY id) FROM (SELECT id FROM violations ORDER BY id LIMIT 50) s),'[]'::jsonb)) FROM violations;

WITH violations AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT min(id) id FROM auction_settlement_lines WHERE auction_result_line_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY auction_result_line_id HAVING count(*)>1) SELECT jsonb_build_object('code','SETTLEMENT_DUPLICATE_RESULT_LINK','kind','INVARIANT','count',count(*),'sampleIds',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(id ORDER BY id) FROM (SELECT id FROM violations ORDER BY id LIMIT 50) s),'[]'::jsonb)) FROM violations;

WITH violations AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT l.id FROM auction_settlement_lines l LEFT JOIN auction_result_lines r ON r.id=l.auction_result_line_id WHERE l.auction_result_line_id IS NOT NULL AND r.id IS NULL) SELECT jsonb_build_object('code','SETTLEMENT_DANGLING_RESULT','kind','INVARIANT','count',count(*),'sampleIds',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(id ORDER BY id) FROM (SELECT id FROM violations ORDER BY id LIMIT 50) s),'[]'::jsonb)) FROM violations;

WITH violations AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT l.id FROM auction_settlement_lines l JOIN auction_result_lines r ON r.id=l.auction_result_line_id WHERE l.amount::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM r.amount::numeric OR l.quantity IS DISTINCT FROM r.quantity OR l.unit_price IS DISTINCT FROM r.unit_price) SELECT jsonb_build_object('code','SETTLEMENT_SOURCE_AMOUNT_DIFF','kind','SNAPSHOT_REVIEW','count',count(*),'sampleIds',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(id ORDER BY id) FROM (SELECT id FROM violations ORDER BY id LIMIT 50) s),'[]'::jsonb)) FROM violations;

WITH violations AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT r.id FROM auction_result_lines r WHERE r.amount>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM auction_settlement_lines l WHERE l.auction_result_line_id=r.id)) SELECT jsonb_build_object('code','POSITIVE_AUCTION_RESULT_UNSETTLED','kind','COVERAGE','count',count(*),'sampleIds',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(id ORDER BY id) FROM (SELECT id FROM violations ORDER BY id LIMIT 50) s),'[]'::jsonb)) FROM violations;

WITH violations AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT e.id FROM partner_payment_events e LEFT JOIN sales_slips s ON e.target_type='SALES_SLIP' AND s.id=e.target_id LEFT JOIN auction_settlements a ON e.target_type='AUCTION_SETTLEMENT' AND a.id=e.target_id WHERE (e.target_type='SALES_SLIP' AND s.id IS NULL) OR (e.target_type='AUCTION_SETTLEMENT' AND a.id IS NULL)) SELECT jsonb_build_object('code','PAYMENT_DANGLING_TARGET','kind','INVARIANT','count',count(*),'sampleIds',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(id ORDER BY id) FROM (SELECT id FROM violations ORDER BY id LIMIT 50) s),'[]'::jsonb)) FROM violations;

WITH violations AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT min(id) id FROM partner_payment_events WHERE external_uid IS NOT NULL GROUP BY external_uid HAVING count(*)>1) SELECT jsonb_build_object('code','PAYMENT_DUPLICATE_EXTERNAL_UID','kind','INVARIANT','count',count(*),'sampleIds',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(id ORDER BY id) FROM (SELECT id FROM violations ORDER BY id LIMIT 50) s),'[]'::jsonb)) FROM violations;

WITH violations AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT s.id FROM sales_slips s LEFT JOIN (SELECT target_id,sum(amount)::numeric total FROM partner_payment_events WHERE target_type='SALES_SLIP' AND event_type='PAYMENT_RECEIVED' AND status='FULLY_APPLIED' GROUP BY target_id) e ON e.target_id=s.id WHERE coalesce(s.paid_amount,0)::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM coalesce(e.total,0)) SELECT jsonb_build_object('code','SALES_PAID_EVENT_COVERAGE_DIFF','kind','COVERAGE','count',count(*),'sampleIds',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(id ORDER BY id) FROM (SELECT id FROM violations ORDER BY id LIMIT 50) s),'[]'::jsonb)) FROM violations;

WITH violations AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT s.id FROM auction_settlements s LEFT JOIN (SELECT target_id,sum(amount)::numeric total FROM partner_payment_events WHERE target_type='AUCTION_SETTLEMENT' AND event_type='PAYMENT_RECEIVED' AND status='FULLY_APPLIED' GROUP BY target_id) e ON e.target_id=s.id WHERE s.paid_amount::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM coalesce(e.total,0)) SELECT jsonb_build_object('code','SETTLEMENT_PAID_EVENT_COVERAGE_DIFF','kind','COVERAGE','count',count(*),'sampleIds',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(id ORDER BY id) FROM (SELECT id FROM violations ORDER BY id LIMIT 50) s),'[]'::jsonb)) FROM violations;

WITH violations AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT id FROM work_applied_effects WHERE (mutation_id IS NULL) <> (correlation_id IS NULL)) SELECT jsonb_build_object('code','WORK_INCOMPLETE_MUTATION_LINK','kind','INVARIANT','count',count(*),'sampleIds',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(id ORDER BY id) FROM (SELECT id FROM violations ORDER BY id LIMIT 50) s),'[]'::jsonb)) FROM violations;

WITH violations AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT id FROM work_operation_corrections WHERE (mutation_id IS NULL) <> (correlation_id IS NULL)) SELECT jsonb_build_object('code','WORK_CORRECTION_INCOMPLETE_MUTATION_LINK','kind','INVARIANT','count',count(*),'sampleIds',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(id ORDER BY id) FROM (SELECT id FROM violations ORDER BY id LIMIT 50) s),'[]'::jsonb)) FROM violations;

WITH violations AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT t.id FROM work_operation_targets t LEFT JOIN orchid_groups g ON g.id=t.orchid_group_id WHERE t.orchid_group_id IS NOT NULL AND g.id IS NULL) SELECT jsonb_build_object('code','WORK_TARGET_DANGLING_GROUP','kind','INVARIANT','count',count(*),'sampleIds',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(id ORDER BY id) FROM (SELECT id FROM violations ORDER BY id LIMIT 50) s),'[]'::jsonb)) FROM violations;

WITH violations AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT e.id FROM work_effect_orchid_groups e LEFT JOIN orchid_groups g ON g.id=e.orchid_group_id WHERE g.id IS NULL) SELECT jsonb_build_object('code','WORK_EFFECT_DANGLING_GROUP','kind','INVARIANT','count',count(*),'sampleIds',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(id ORDER BY id) FROM (SELECT id FROM violations ORDER BY id LIMIT 50) s),'[]'::jsonb)) FROM violations;

WITH violations AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT id FROM work_operations WHERE actual_end_at<actual_start_at) SELECT jsonb_build_object('code','WORK_TIME_ORDER_REVIEW','kind','TIME_REVIEW','count',count(*),'sampleIds',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(id ORDER BY id) FROM (SELECT id FROM violations ORDER BY id LIMIT 50) s),'[]'::jsonb)) FROM violations;

WITH violations AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT m.id FROM orchid_group_mutations m WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orchid_group_mutation_entries e WHERE e.mutation_id=m.id)) SELECT jsonb_build_object('code','LEDGER_MUTATION_WITHOUT_ENTRY','kind','INVARIANT','count',count(*),'sampleIds',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(id ORDER BY id) FROM (SELECT id FROM violations ORDER BY id LIMIT 50) s),'[]'::jsonb)) FROM violations;

WITH violations AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT min(id) id FROM orchid_group_mutation_entries GROUP BY orchid_group_id,state_revision_after HAVING count(*)>1) SELECT jsonb_build_object('code','LEDGER_DUPLICATE_GROUP_REVISION','kind','INVARIANT','count',count(*),'sampleIds',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(id ORDER BY id) FROM (SELECT id FROM violations ORDER BY id LIMIT 50) s),'[]'::jsonb)) FROM violations;

WITH violations AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT id FROM (SELECT e.*,lag(state_revision_after) OVER chain previous_revision,lag(after_state) OVER chain previous_after,row_number() OVER chain position FROM orchid_group_mutation_entries e WINDOW chain AS (PARTITION BY orchid_group_id ORDER BY state_revision_after,id)) c WHERE (position=1 AND NOT ((entry_kind='BASELINE' AND state_revision_before IS NULL AND state_revision_after=0) OR (entry_kind='CREATE' AND state_revision_before IS NULL AND state_revision_after=1))) OR (position>1 AND (state_revision_before IS DISTINCT FROM previous_revision OR state_revision_after IS DISTINCT FROM previous_revision+1 OR before_state IS DISTINCT FROM previous_after))) SELECT jsonb_build_object('code','LEDGER_CHAIN_DISCONTINUITY','kind','INVARIANT','count',count(*),'sampleIds',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(id ORDER BY id) FROM (SELECT id FROM violations ORDER BY id LIMIT 50) s),'[]'::jsonb)) FROM violations;

WITH violations AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT a.id FROM audit_events a LEFT JOIN orchid_group_mutations m ON m.id=a.mutation_id WHERE a.mutation_id IS NOT NULL AND m.id IS NULL) SELECT jsonb_build_object('code','AUDIT_DANGLING_MUTATION','kind','INVARIANT','count',count(*),'sampleIds',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(id ORDER BY id) FROM (SELECT id FROM violations ORDER BY id LIMIT 50) s),'[]'::jsonb)) FROM violations;

WITH violations AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT id FROM work_operations WHERE planned_end_date<planned_start_date) SELECT jsonb_build_object('code','WORK_PLANNED_DATE_ORDER','kind','INVARIANT','count',count(*),'sampleIds',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(id ORDER BY id) FROM (SELECT id FROM violations ORDER BY id LIMIT 50) s),'[]'::jsonb)) FROM violations;
COMMIT;
targetedReviewSql: BEGIN ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY;
SET LOCAL row_security=off; SET LOCAL lock_timeout='3s'; SET LOCAL statement_timeout='5min';

SELECT jsonb_build_object('report','NEGATIVE_ITEM_DETAIL','itemId',i.id,'slipId',i.sales_slip_id,'saleDate',s.sale_date,'quantity',i.quantity,'unitPrice',i.unit_price,'amount',i.amount,'amountMatchesMultiplication',i.amount::numeric=i.quantity::numeric*i.unit_price::numeric,'itemHasReturnOrAdjustmentWord',coalesce(i.memo,'')~'(반품|반환|환불|상계|차감|취소|조정)','slipHasReturnOrAdjustmentWord',coalesce(s.memo,'')~'(반품|반환|환불|상계|차감|취소|조정)') FROM sales_slip_items i JOIN sales_slips s ON s.id=i.sales_slip_id WHERE i.quantity<=0 OR i.unit_price<0 OR i.amount<0 ORDER BY i.id;

SELECT jsonb_build_object('report','NEGATIVE_SLIP_DETAIL','slipId',id,'saleDate',sale_date,'totalAmount',total_amount,'paidAmount',paid_amount,'remainingAmount',remaining_amount,'status',sales_status) FROM sales_slips WHERE total_amount<0 OR paid_amount<0 ORDER BY id;
SELECT jsonb_build_object('report','SALES_TYPE_COUNTS','salesType',sales_type,'count',count(*)) FROM sales_slips GROUP BY sales_type;

SELECT jsonb_build_object('report','PAYMENT_EVENT_COUNTS','type',event_type,'status',status,'targetType',target_type,'count',count(*)) FROM partner_payment_events GROUP BY event_type,status,target_type ORDER BY event_type,status,target_type;

SELECT jsonb_build_object('report','WORK_DATE_ORDER','plannedEndBeforeStart',count(*) FILTER (WHERE planned_end_date<planned_start_date),'actualEndBeforeStart',count(*) FILTER (WHERE actual_end_at<actual_start_at),'actualEndEarlierCalendarDay',count(*) FILTER (WHERE actual_end_at::date<actual_start_at::date)) FROM work_operations;

SELECT jsonb_build_object('report','WORK_TIME_SAMPLE','workId',w.id,'workType',t.code,'status',w.status,'actualStartAt',w.actual_start_at,'actualEndAt',w.actual_end_at,'createdAt',w.created_at,'plannedStartDate',w.planned_start_date) FROM work_operations w JOIN work_types t ON t.id=w.work_type_id WHERE w.actual_end_at<w.actual_start_at ORDER BY w.id LIMIT 8;

WITH groups AS (SELECT min(r.id) first_id,count(*) rows,count(DISTINCT a.id) attempts,max(r.amount) amount FROM auction_result_lines r JOIN auction_attempts a ON a.id=r.auction_attempt_id GROUP BY a.shipment_lot_id,r.auction_date,r.auction_grade,r.quantity,r.unit_price,r.amount,r.inspection_status HAVING count(*)>1) SELECT jsonb_build_object('report','IDENTICAL_AUCTION_RESULT_GROUPS','totalGroups',count(*),'sameAttemptGroups',count(*) FILTER (WHERE attempts=1),'multipleAttemptGroups',count(*) FILTER (WHERE attempts>1),'positiveAmountGroups',count(*) FILTER (WHERE amount>0),'zeroAmountGroups',count(*) FILTER (WHERE amount=0),'excessRows',sum(rows-1)) FROM groups;

SELECT jsonb_build_object('report','CONSTRAINT_COUNTS','kind',contype,'validated',convalidated,'count',count(*)) FROM pg_constraint c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.connamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' GROUP BY contype,convalidated ORDER BY contype,convalidated;
